concerns.text: Task T101 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it creates the project package structure that all subsequent tasks depend on. Running it in parallel with any later task could cause race conditions (e.g., missing `__init__.py` or directories). Remove the `[P]` tag or ensure T101 is executed exclusively before any consumer tasks.

Task T107 is also marked `[P]` yet it depends on artifacts produced by T105 (model) and possibly T106 (SHAP) to measure full‑pipeline runtime and seed stability. Parallel execution with those producers would break the verification logic. The `[P]` tag should be removed.

User‑story grouping is violated: US2 tasks (T105, T107) are interleaved with US3 tasks (T106, T108). Each US block should be an independently‑shippable unit, i.e., all tasks for a story should be contiguous and not depend on tasks from another story. Reorder to keep US2 tasks together (e.g., T105 → T107) before moving to US3 (T106 → T108), or adjust story assignments accordingly.
